skill.summary: Conduct personalized cold outreach focused on the prospect's problem, use small asks, follow up 2–3 times, and measure reply rates to acquire first customers.

latestVersion.changelog:
## growth-cold-outreach v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launched first version of the cold outreach skill, focused on acquiring first customers.
- Outlined key rules: personalized outreach, problem-led messaging, small asks, proper follow-ups, and prioritizing reply rates over send volume.
- Provided channel-specific reply rate benchmarks.
- Listed common mistakes to avoid in early-stage cold outreach.
- Included a tip about validating cold outreach strategies with Racoonn AI-simulated user testing and an invitation to the API waitlist.
